name: commit-graph-peer-reads
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i; done &&
git tag -a v1 -m v1 && git commit-graph write --reachable
probes: test -f @REPO@/.git/objects/info/commit-graph && git -C @REPO@ commit-graph verify && echo PEER-VERIFY-OK
git -C @REPO@ fsck --strict 2>&1 | grep -viE 'checking|^$' | tail -1; echo fsck-done

name: midx-peer-reads
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i && git repack -q -d; done &&
git multi-pack-index write
probes: test -f @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/multi-pack-index && git -C @REPO@ multi-pack-index verify && echo PEER-MIDX-VERIFY-OK

name: bitmap-peer-reads
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i; done &&
git repack -q -a -d --write-bitmap-index
probes: ls @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/pack-*.bitmap >/dev/null 2>&1 && git -C @REPO@ rev-list --test-bitmap HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PEER-TESTBITMAP-OK

name: midx-bitmap-peer-reads
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i && git repack -q -d; done &&
git multi-pack-index write --bitmap
probes: test -f @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/multi-pack-index && git -C @REPO@ multi-pack-index verify && echo PEER-MIDX-BITMAP-VERIFY-OK
